mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state (battle_id, current_player, round_no, status, winner, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{battleId}, COALESCE(#{currentPlayer}, 0), COALESCE(#{roundNo}, 1), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ONGOING'), #{winner}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (battle_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state SET current_player = #{currentPlayer}, round_no = #{roundNo}, status = #{status}, winner = #{winner}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE battle_id = #{battleId}
UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state SET current_player = #{nextPlayer}, round_no = #{nextRound}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE battle_id = #{battleId}
UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state SET status = #{status}, winner = #{winner}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE battle_id = #{battleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state SELECT * FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state_backup WHERE battle_id = #{battleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_battle_state SET current_player = #{humanPlayer}, round_no = 1, status = 'ONGOING', winner = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE battle_id = #{battleId}
